import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
})

BLUE = '#2166AC'
RED = '#B2182B'

# Data — Panel (a) Autoregressive Generation (N=5)
gen_beta = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0]
gen_gar =  [0.028, 0.029, 0.035, 0.062, 0.680, 0.959]
gen_ppl =  [1.41, 1.39, 1.36, 1.41, 1.91, 4.22]

# Data — Panel (b) Teacher-Forced (N=200)
tf_beta = [0.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 10.0]
tf_gar =  [0.535, 0.611, 0.788, 0.817, 0.833, 0.977]
tf_ppl =  [2.62, 2.69, 2.93, 3.49, 6.15, 505.21]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 2.5))

def setup_twin(ax):
    """Create right y-axis with visible spine."""
    axr = ax.twinx()
    axr.spines['right'].set_visible(True)
    axr.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    axr.spines['right'].set_color(RED)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color(BLUE)
    return axr

# ============================================================
# Panel (a) — Autoregressive Generation
# ============================================================
ax1r = setup_twin(ax1)

# Phase transition shading β ∈ [2, 5]
ax1.axvspan(2, 5, alpha=0.10, color='#F0C040', zorder=0)
ax1.text(3.5, 0.92, 'phase transition',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#9A7B00', ha='center', va='top', fontstyle='italic')

# TF baseline reference line
ax1.axhline(y=0.535, color='#888888', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax1.text(6.8, 0.555, 'TF baseline (β=0)',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#888888', va='bottom')

# GAR (left axis, blue, solid circles)
ax1.plot(gen_beta, gen_gar, '-o', color=BLUE, markersize=5,
         markerfacecolor=BLUE, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.6,
         zorder=3, label='Mid-GAR')

# PPL (right axis, red, dashed triangles)
ax1r.plot(gen_beta, gen_ppl, '--^', color=RED, markersize=5,
          markerfacecolor=RED, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.6,
          zorder=3, label='PPL')

ax1.set_ylabel('Mid-GAR', color=BLUE)
ax1r.set_ylabel('PPL', color=RED)
ax1.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.05)
ax1r.set_ylim(0.8, 5.0)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.5, 10.8)
ax1.set_xticks(gen_beta)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', colors=BLUE)
ax1r.tick_params(axis='y', colors=RED)
ax1.set_title('(a) Autoregressive Generation', pad=8)

# Combined legend
h1, l1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
h2, l2 = ax1r.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(h1 + h2, l1 + l2, loc='center left', framealpha=0.9,
           edgecolor='none', borderpad=0.4)

# ============================================================
# Panel (b) — Teacher-Forced
# ============================================================
ax2r = setup_twin(ax2)

# GAR (left axis, blue, solid circles)
ax2.plot(tf_beta, tf_gar, '-o', color=BLUE, markersize=5,
         markerfacecolor=BLUE, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.6,
         zorder=3, label='Mid-GAR')

# PPL (right axis, red, dashed triangles) — log scale
ax2r.plot(tf_beta, tf_ppl, '--^', color=RED, markersize=5,
          markerfacecolor=RED, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.6,
          zorder=3, label='PPL')

ax2.set_ylabel('Mid-GAR', color=BLUE)
ax2r.set_ylabel('PPL (log scale)', color=RED)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.05)
ax2r.set_yscale('log')
ax2r.set_ylim(1, 800)
ax2r.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax2r.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())
ax2r.set_yticks([1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 500])
ax2r.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5, 10.8)
ax2.set_xticks(tf_beta)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', colors=BLUE)
ax2r.tick_params(axis='y', colors=RED)
ax2.set_title('(b) Teacher-Forced', pad=8)

h1, l1 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
h2, l2 = ax2r.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax2.legend(h1 + h2, l1 + l2, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9,
           edgecolor='none', borderpad=0.4)

# Shared x-axis label
fig.text(0.5, -0.02, 'β (Steering Strength)', ha='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.04, 1, 1])

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_11/projects/turn_residual_gating/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig5_attention_steering.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig5_attention_steering.png', dpi=300)
print('Saved fig5_attention_steering.pdf and .png')
plt.close()
